name: dumbbell curl to press
description: Curl the dumbbells and keep going into an overhead press, training the arms and shoulders in one smooth rep.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl both weights up to shoulder height without swinging.
Rotate your wrists slightly and press the weights overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then back down to your sides.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
